title: Director of AI and Legal Technology
description:
Are you the kind of technology leader who can look at a messy workflow, spot the friction, and build practical systems that actually make people’s jobs easier?

Do you know how to use AI, automation, data, and legal technology to improve efficiency without creating chaos?

Can you translate technical possibilities into real operational improvements that attorneys, staff, and leadership can actually use?

Final question: When faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?

** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

- If you have any questions, please email recruit@crisp.co only.

- Please do not reach out through our website's contact information (telephone, email, or web chat) or via direct messaging on any social media platform.

- To Apply: Submit your application by clicking the "Apply" button and applying on the Crisp Recruit page that opens.

**RECRUITERS DO NOT CONTACT**

Disability Law Group is dedicated to guiding individuals and families through some of life's most challenging moments. From Social Security Disability benefits to Veterans' claims, we advocate for people who need strong, compassionate representation. 

Our team is based in Troy, Michigan, and we're known for combining deep legal expertise with a client-first culture that values empathy, precision, and results.

We've grown steadily by staying committed to both our mission and our people. At Disability Law Group, success is measured not only in cases won but in lives changed. This is where advocacy meets accountability, and where every member of our team plays a role in creating impact.

This role is ideal for a strategic, hands-on technology leader who enjoys building better systems, improving business processes, and helping teams work smarter through technology.

The Director of Technology will lead the firm's technology strategy while personally driving key initiatives involving CRM implementation, workflow optimization, reporting, automation, AI adoption, and operational improvement. Success in this role requires someone who is equally comfortable planning long-term technology strategy and getting into the trenches to solve day-to-day business challenges.

One of the first priorities will be helping the firm evaluate, implement, and optimize its next CRM/case management platform while improving reporting, dashboards, workflows, and overall operational efficiency. AI is an important part of the firm's future, but the focus is on applying practical technology solutions that improve how attorneys and staff serve clients and not just implementing technology for technology's sake.

What you’ll do:

- Technology Strategy & Operational Leadership: Develop and execute the firm's technology roadmap while partnering with leadership to identify opportunities for operational improvement, scalability, and long-term growth.

- CRM Strategy, Evaluation & Implementation: Lead the evaluation, selection, implementation, and optimization of the firm's next CRM/case management platform. Work closely with leadership to improve workflows, reporting, dashboards, automation, and user adoption. Experience with Salesforce is highly preferred.

- Workflow Optimization & Process Improvement: Evaluate current business processes, identify bottlenecks, simplify workflows, and implement practical technology solutions that reduce manual effort and improve consistency across the firm.

- Reporting, Analytics & KPI Visibility: Design and improve dashboards, reporting, and operational metrics so leadership has clear visibility into firm performance, productivity, and opportunities for improvement.

- AI & Automation: Identify practical opportunities to leverage AI and automation within existing business processes and technology platforms. Help the firm responsibly adopt AI capabilities that improve efficiency while maintaining confidentiality, accuracy, and client trust.

- Technology Operations & IT Partnership: Work closely with the existing IT team member and external technology vendors to improve infrastructure, evaluate managed service providers (MSPs), strengthen security, and ensure technology investments support the firm's long-term objectives.

- Training & Change Management: Train attorneys and staff on new systems and processes, develop documentation, drive adoption, and ensure technology changes are successfully implemented across the organization.

- Governance & Technology Planning: Develop standards, documentation, and governance practices that support responsible technology use, data quality, security, and continuous improvement.

What we’re looking for: 

- Experience leading CRM implementation, business systems, or technology transformation initiatives.

- Strong understanding of workflow analysis, business process improvement, and operational efficiency.

- Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution.

- Experience implementing or optimizing CRM, ERP, case management, or other enterprise business platforms.

- Strong reporting, dashboard, and KPI development experience.

- Experience working across leadership, business users, vendors, and technical teams.

- Ability to manage technology projects from planning through implementation.

- Strong communication, collaboration, and change management skills.

- Comfortable working independently while helping build the firm's long-term technology capabilities.

- Proactive problem solver with a builder's mindset.

Nice to have:

- Salesforce or other CRM implementation, administration, or architecture experience.

- Experience with Filevine, Prevail, Clio, Litify, SmartAdvocate, or other CRM/case management platforms.

- Experience evaluating CRM platforms and leading technology selection projects.

- IT operations or infrastructure experience, including vendor management or managed service providers (MSPs).

- Experience implementing workflow automation, AI tools, integrations, dashboards, or reporting solutions.

- Experience working in legal services, professional services, healthcare, insurance, or another highly regulated industry.

- Familiarity with APIs, low-code/no-code automation platforms, and business intelligence tools.

Why you should work here: 

- High-impact role: Your work will directly influence how the firm operates, serves clients, and scales for future growth.

- Opportunity to build: Help shape the firm's technology strategy while implementing practical solutions that improve day-to-day operations.

- Mission-driven organization: Support a team dedicated to helping individuals and families through some of life's most challenging moments.

- Collaborative leadership: Work directly with firm leadership on meaningful technology initiatives that have visible business impact.

- Room to grow: This role is designed for someone who wants to build a technology function, develop long-term strategy, and grow alongside a rapidly expanding organization.

At Disability Law Group, you'll do more than manage technology.

You'll build systems, improve processes, modernize operations, and help shape the future of a growing law firm through practical, hands-on leadership.

If you're excited to solve problems, build better workflows, and make technology work for people and not the other way around.

title: Head of AI Product & Architecture Consulting
description:
We’re hiring a Head of AI Product & Architecture Consulting!

Employment Type: Full-Time/Direct Hire

Location: Richmond, VA, Atlanta, GA, Washington, DC, New York City & Charlotte, NC Metro Areas

Location Type: Hybrid - 1-2 days onsite per week - Home Office/Local Ippon office

About Ippon:

The Ippon story started in 2002 in Paris, France - cue in the accordion. Our founder and CEO Stéphane Nomis used his unique experience as an international Judo champion to create a culture based on the sports values of ambition and excellence. Our USA Headquarters office is located in Richmond, VA, with additional offices in New York, NY, Washington DC, and Atlanta, GA. We are a technology consulting firm that specializes in helping accelerate our client’s digital roadmap in the areas of Product Management, Cloud, DevOps, Data, AI, and Software Engineering. Expanding partnerships is the top priority in our strategy, and we are proud to be a Premier Snowflake Partner and an Advanced AWS Partner. Ippon stands out through its financial services industry expertise, technical excellence, and a distinctive coaching mindset.

About the position:

The Practice Head of AI Product & Architecture will lead Ippon's APA practice, combining deep expertise in software development, product engineering, agile delivery, architecture, and applied AI. This role is responsible for growing a high-performing consulting team, shaping the practice's methods and offerings, and ensuring delivery excellence across complex client engagements.

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with strong consulting instincts and a track record of delivering meaningful technology outcomes. They bring deep grounding in modern engineering practices and software craft, alongside hands-on AI experience — applied practically across product development, software delivery, customer experiences, and enterprise operations.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Practice Leadership & Team Development

- 
Lead and grow the practice across people, offerings, delivery standards, and market positioning.

- 
Continuously improve consulting methods, delivery playbooks, technical standards, and ways of working in collaboration with Customer Success and Senior Leadership.

- 
Build a strong team culture grounded in software craft, product thinking, architectural discipline, and practical AI adoption — with an emphasis on psychological safety, accountability, and measurable improvement.

- 
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing consultants, engineers, architects, product leaders, and delivery practitioners.

Delivery Excellence

- 
Provide senior oversight across client engagements involving software development, product engineering, AI-enabled delivery, modernization, and architecture.

- 
Ensure solutions are maintainable, secure, scalable, and aligned to client outcomes, promoting modern practices such as continuous delivery, test automation, observability, and platform thinking.

- 
Use metrics such as DORA, flow metrics, and business outcome measures to drive evidence-based improvement.

- 
Help clients adopt flexible, sustainable delivery models that balance speed, governance, quality, and business value — coaching cross-functional teams on effective collaboration across product, engineering, architecture, security, and compliance.

AI Leadership

- 
In collaboration with the CTO, shape APA's approach to applied AI across product engineering, software development, architecture, and delivery transformation.

- 
Help clients identify and pursue practical AI use cases that improve delivery speed, product quality, customer experience, or operational efficiency.

- 
Guide teams in the responsible use of AI-assisted development tools, agentic workflows, and intelligent applications, with clear understanding of associated risks including governance, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations.

- 
Partner with Ippon's data and cloud leaders to connect APA's AI capabilities with strengths in AWS, Snowflake, and data architecture.

Client and Thought Leadership

- 
Support sales pursuits, proposals, and executive conversations — translating ambiguous client needs into clear engagement strategies, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.

- 
Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders at the intersection of product, engineering, architecture, data, cloud, AI, and governance.

- 
Define and package APA offerings across AI-enabled product engineering, software modernization, delivery effectiveness, and engineering excellence.

- 
Drive brand awareness through thought leadership initiatives including events, blogs, white papers, and client success stories.

Competencies we are looking for:

Minimum Qualifications:

- 
5+ years of consulting experience

- 
5+ years of experience leading software engineering, product engineering, architecture, or technology consulting teams.

- 
5+ years of experience building, managing, coaching, and growing high-performing technical teams.

- 
7+ years of experience and deep understanding of modern software development practices, including software architecture, software craft, DevOps, CI/CD, testing strategies, and cloud-native delivery.

- 
7+ years of experience with product development and product-oriented ways of working.

- 
Strong working knowledge of agile delivery practices, with the judgment to adapt methods to fit client context rather than applying process mechanically.

- 
Hands-on experience with AI tools, AI-enabled software development, intelligent applications, or applied enterprise AI use cases.

- 
7+ years of experience in financial services, banking, insurance, capital markets, or related regulated industries

- 
Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to manage people, priorities, offerings, delivery quality, and practice operations simultaneously.

- 
Strong client-facing communication skills, including the ability to engage credibly with executives, product leaders, engineering leaders, architects, and delivery teams.

- 
Experience supporting business development, proposal creation, solution design, or account growth in a consulting environment.

- 
Ability to travel up to 20% of the time

Preferred Qualifications:

- 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 
Experience leading a consulting practice, capability, center of excellence, or large technology delivery organization.

- 
Experience using DORA metrics, SPACE, flow metrics, or other engineering effectiveness frameworks to improve delivery performance.

- 
Experience with AI-assisted development tools, agentic workflows, LLM-enabled applications, or enterprise AI governance.

- 
Familiarity with AWS, Snowflake, modern data platforms, and cloud-native architecture.

- 
Experience with modernization programs, legacy system transformation, platform engineering, or large-scale digital product delivery.

- 
Experience creating market-facing offerings, white papers, executive presentations, workshops, and assessment frameworks.

- 
Understanding of regulatory requirements and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) within the Financial Services and Insurance industries.

- 
Knowledge of IT strategy and management

- 
Demonstrated experience of presenting talks at conferences, publishing white papers, and public speaking.

What we offer:

- 
Competitive salary – Great starting salaries for well qualified candidates

- 
Generous Paid Time Off policy - Ippon offers flexible time off to help you be your best

- 
Health, dental, and vision insurance – We are dedicated to helping our employees live healthier lives through comprehensive health programs

- 
401k with company match - Ippon offers an industry leading 401(k) matching plan

- 
Family Leave - We support the importance of family and offer maternity, paternity and family medical leave plans

- 
The chance to work in a startup-esque environment with a fun, smart, and healthy work environment, focused on our values, teamwork, and 5406 custom Slack emojis

Salary range listed is base salary.

Role is eligible for a company performance bonus, as well as MBO's.

We value the diversity and different perspectives each of our employees bring to Ippon Technologies.

Ippon Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Visit us on LinkedIn or at https://ipponusa.com/ to learn more.

So, do YOU speak Ippon?
